summary: Butler County, MO tower site that Forest Lookouts lists as Removed; onX trail listings describe a 1962 survey marker, a 1980 topo appearance and remaining foundations at the end of a forest road.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts lists the tower as Removed; the onX listing says the one online claim of removal gives no date

access.note: Forest Service road FS 3113A leads from FS 3113 to the former towersite; the onX listing mentions no gate or closure

visit.trail_note: Breeze Tower Spur A (FS 3113A) is a natural gravel and dirt road, 0.7 miles long, within the Poplar Bluff Unit, leading to a turnaround loop beside the former towersite

notes_for_editor: Forest Lookouts supplies the county, the agency and Removed. The onX trail listings supply the site description, the 1962 survey marker and the 1980 topo note; they are trail-guide writing, not official records. No build date, height, staffing or removal date was found. The 1980 topo claim could be checked against the USGS Williamsville quadrangle, 1980 edition. The Poplar Bluff Ranger District would hold any Forest Service record of construction or removal. Access is recorded as public on the strength of the forest road listing; no gate or closure notice was found.
